text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visiting Ivorian Interior Minister Emile Constant Bombet says his country wants to benefit from Morocco's experience in regionalisation.
- Egyptian actor Adil Imam to perform play in Morocco with box office receipts going to al-Qods (Jerusalem) fund.
- Morocco's legislative elections will take place late September.
- Discovery of 100 kgs (220 pounds) of drug, believed to be cocaine, washed up on a Casablanca beach.
- Election of prefectoral and provincial assemblies due on July 15.
- Health workers start a two-day strike to press for pay increases and other benefits.
